What I Use

September 4, 2026
  1. Hardware
  2. Software
  3. Services

Hardware

  • Lenovo LOQ laptop (personal), Framework laptop (work).

  • Google Pixel 9a phone.

  • Wide IKEA GALANT desk (discontinued).

  • 65" curved 4k TV, attached to the wall 1ft behind the desk so the image fills my field of view and 96dpi text is comfortable to read.

  • Unitek KVM switch to swap which laptop is “live”.

  • MOKOSE CS-lens 4k webcam next to the TV for meetings.

  • High-output LED light in an IKEA REGOLIT shade for mood regulation and for the webcam.

  • USB microphone with boom but I recently got a better mic arm.

  • Sony WH1000XM2 headphones.

  • TOSLINK-to-bluetooth adapter, so headphones get HDMI audio passed through from the TV.

  • TONTRU 101-key mechanical keyboard. It’s affordable, rigid, and thocky, and has a volume control knob.

Software

  • Fedora desktop operating system with Gnome 50. I occasionally miss XFCE.

  • Debian server operating system.

  • GrapheneOS OS for Android with a privacy focus.

  • SyncThing file sync. P2P alternative to Dropbox, supports mobile and desktop. Synchronizes folders of content across all my devices.

  • Mise Dev environment manager, replacing nvm, pyenv, venv, and dozens of others. Great DX.

  • Jujutsu Git-compatible VCS, better DX, better mental model.

  • VSCodium IDE. VSCode with less Microsoft.

  • Obsidian for notes and reference.

  • KeePassXC secret management.

Services

  • FastMail email, calendar, and contact hosting.

  • DartNode VPS. Good value and specs, lets me bring my own server OS image. Crappy billing system.

  • NameSilo domain registrar. Good prices, doesn’t charge extra for domain privacy.

  • Umami analytics, self-hosted.

  • Forgejo git forge, self-hosted. Mirroring to GitHub for now.

  • Webhook to pull static sites when they are built.

  • Shaarli link site, self-hosted.

  • HedgeDoc markdown document collaboration, self-hosted.

I love hearing from visitors! If you have thoughts or comments please email me, you'll make my day.
